biology: The host is the London plane.
soldier: Soldier head yellowish brown, mandibles dark brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.62–0.66, the sides almost parallel and slightly expanded at the middle, the posterior margin of the head capsule slightly projecting outwards. The frontal region is slightly raised, the middle of the frons almost flat. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the transparent region at its apex projecting like a pointer, about 0.046 mm long, the apical hairs long, the subapical and lateral-apical hairs short and fine. The mandibles are long and strong, their apices rather curved, the mandibular condyle visible; the mandibular length about 0.60 times the length of the head capsule and about 0.93 times the width of the head. Antennae with 16–17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, its anterolateral margins expanding trapezoidally behind, slightly concave at the middle, the waist region slender with the sides almost parallel, the waist constriction index 0.28–0.31. The pronotum is kidney-shaped, 1.66 times as wide as long, its anterior margin with a broad V-shaped shallow notch, the sides together with the posterior margin forming a broad arc, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, the anterior margin more than twice as wide as the posterior, with about two long hairs in the middle region.
